# Understanding Online Exam Cheating: A Guide for Educators

## Introduction

The rise of online proctoring has fundamentally changed how institutions verify student work. While these systems offer convenience and security, they also create new vulnerabilities that students can exploit. Understanding these techniques is essential for maintaining academic integrity.

## 1. Screen Sharing and Remote Control

One of the most common methods involves screen sharing. Students often use tools like TeamViewer, AnyDesk, or similar software to share their entire desktop with a remote operator. The operator can then control the student’s mouse and keyboard to navigate the exam interface, select answers, or even type directly into the browser.
